dimension_policy.note_e_f_j: E, F, and J are Cursor-scale relative-stress regimes after this update. They do not represent absolute high-dimensional or underdetermined inference. Dimensions are sampled regime-agnostically from the Cursor Poisson policy; regime labels are assigned post-hoc by realized-dimension rank.
dimension_policy.p_total_definition: total observed features presented to the model (p_signal + p_noise)

regime_specific_dimension_conditions.E_high_dim_dense: upper 25% of realized p_total within split (dense coefficients); Cursor-scale relative high-dimensional stress
regime_specific_dimension_conditions.F_high_dim_sparse: upper 25% of realized p_total within split (sparse coefficients); Cursor-scale relative high-dimensional stress
regime_specific_dimension_conditions.J_low_n_high_p: upper 20% p_total AND lowest 20% n/p ratio within split; NEVER underdetermined (n >= 5*p guaranteed); Cursor-scale most-information-constrained valid regime
